It is not PASS_FOR_CONTRACT for three reasons: the rows marked "as in rev 2" have no fixed quotes or items, the COMPLETION_INTEGRATION.md rows fail the design's own model, and the BH short-form clauses are not mechanically caught. findings.location: DESIGN §5 Gate paths; vector "an edited pinned file"; §3.10 byte source
findings.finding: Every read is at 2043cc27, so the base bytes of a pinned file never change and "an edited pinned file" cannot be detected by the model or the layer as specified. No check ties pinned paths to the packet's own changed files, although the gate-path check already reads that list. So "nothing pinned is edited" is enforced only by older validators.
findings.requiredChange: Add a model check: no path in supersedes, amends or notAmended.pinned is among MET-LIVE-002's changed files (its YAML allowedPaths and its authority changedFiles). findings.finding: The gate says every hit at the mechanics base "that is not at 2043cc27" is dispositioned, with 0 uncovered. But hits are {path, line}, and the named catalogs (MDP, DS, 00-harness-engineering.md, task-packets/README.md) are prepended every packet, so their lines shift. Slots 259 and 260 will add authority files whose baselinePackets name task-packets/CONF-LIVE-003.yaml, which are new hit files. The design does not say where post-base dispositions are recorded, and the record and its test are fixed at 2043cc27.
findings.requiredChange: Make the gate an exact algorithm.
findings.buildRule: Before the pre-check, at the mechanics base M, the build does this. (1) It runs the §3.10 search (with S3-1 and S3-9) at M. (2) It refuses if any supersedes, amends or notAmended.pinned path has a sha256 at M that differs from the record. (3) A hit at M is covered by class, whatever its line number, if its file is a recorded notAmended.named file or matches a named class path rule from S3-10 (docs/history/*, architecture/*-inputs/** other than broker-handoff-inputs, architecture/*/round*/**, architecture/**/review-round*.json, architecture/*-authority.json). (4) A hit in a recorded line-disposition file is covered only if that file's sha256 at M equals the record's. (5) Every other hit at M (a new file, or a changed line-disposition file) goes into the pre-check report with a disposition from the record's closed vocabulary. The build refuses if any of them fits no disposition or assigns a moved item. (6) The adopted record is not changed. The report's list is reviewed in the packet review.

findings.finding: As written, the search is not executable. `git grep -n -E` refuses the short-form pattern: running it at 2043cc27 returned rc 128, "repetition-operator operand invalid" (lookbehind is not ERE). The paragraph rule names only .md, .json and .yaml. "Blank" and the meaning of \w (Unicode or ASCII) are not fixed. At the base, blank-as-whitespace makes no difference in the files checked.
findings.buildRule: The declared search runs as follows. The candidate files are the union of `git grep -l -E 'CONF-LIVE-00[345]'` and `git grep -l -E '(^|[^[:alnum:]_./:-])00[345]([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|(packet|packets|edit|Product|product|same|Native)00[345]'`, each run at the commit with the pathspecs `docs architecture task-packets ':!architecture/enforcement-test-plan' ':!docs/alpha-2/ENFORCEMENT_TEST_PLAN.md' ':!architecture/artifact-edges' ':!tools'`. Each candidate's bytes come from `git show <commit>:<path>`; they are decoded as UTF-8 and split on "\n". The §3.10 patterns are applied with Python 3 `re` on str. A blank line is one whose str.strip() is empty. A paragraph is the maximal non-blank run for .md files and the line itself for every other extension. At 2043cc27 this gives 278 long-form files with 2386 long-form lines, plus 60 short-form candidate files.

findings.finding: INPUTS_PINNED (the broker-handoff inputs) also matches INPUTS_SNAPSHOT's rule (architecture/*-inputs/). Nothing checks that a file's class matches its path rule, so a pinned guide could be filed as a snapshot and escape both quoting and line dispositions.
findings.requiredChange: Give each class a closed path rule and check it.
findings.buildRule:
Class path rules, checked by the model with the negative vector "a file in a class whose path rule it fails":
- MERGED_PACKET_YAML: task-packets/*.yaml.
- CLOSED_RECORD and RECORD_EMBEDDED_TEXT: architecture/*.json, one level; CLOSED_RECORD is the exact list in §3.9.
- INPUTS_PINNED: architecture/broker-handoff-inputs/*.
- LINEAGE_GUIDE: docs/alpha-2/{CONFORMANCE_COMPLETION, CONFORMANCE_PUBLICATION, LOCAL_ACCEPTANCE_REVALIDATION, SUCCESSOR_CHECKPOINT_REPAIR}.md.
- LIVING_CATALOG: the eight §3.9 paths, plus docs/alpha-2/COMPLETION_INTEGRATION.md under S3-5.
- HISTORY_SNAPSHOT: docs/history/*.
- INPUTS_SNAPSHOT: architecture/*-inputs/**, except architecture/broker-handoff-inputs/.
- ROUND_SNAPSHOT: architecture/*/round*/**.
- REVIEW_RECORD: architecture/**/review-round*.json not under a round*/ directory.
- AUTHORITY_TEXT: architecture/*-authority.json.
A path that matches two rules takes the first in this order: INPUTS_PINNED, ROUND_SNAPSHOT, REVIEW_RECORD, AUTHORITY_TEXT, INPUTS_SNAPSHOT, HISTORY_SNAPSHOT, then the listed classes. Counts at 2043cc27: MERGED_PACKET_YAML 32, CLOSED_RECORD 10, INPUTS_PINNED 1, LINEAGE_GUIDE 4, LIVING_CATALOG 8 (9 with S3-5), HISTORY_SNAPSHOT 1, INPUTS_SNAPSHOT 19, ROUND_SNAPSHOT 16, REVIEW_RECORD 3, AUTHORITY_TEXT 92.
